phase_name: Regression test for mutex hold time and concurrent status flips

objectives.description: Create test-state-write-regen-timing.sh with fixture and stub conventions
Case 1: prove mutex released before regeneration via controlled stub + concurrent scope-acquire probe
Case 2: two concurrent --regen-todo status flips both succeed, no lost update
Case 3: guest mode still serializes regeneration, outer holder's mutex untouched
Adversarial check: revert Phase 1 fix in scratch copy, confirm case 1 fails

notes: Adversarial check verified against a scratch copy: case 1 FAILS (exit 1, timeout acquiring specs/.scope-lock) when release_mutex is moved back after the regen block, while cases 2 and 3 still pass unaffected. Confirms the regression guard is load-bearing. git status --short confirmed exactly one new untracked file (test-state-write-regen-timing.sh) under agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/ after this phase; the concurrently-modified verify-deploy.sh belongs to another in-flight agent and was left unstaged.
